Final Fantasy II.name: Final Fantasy II
Final Fantasy II.summary: The WonderSwan Color version of Final Fantasy II included completely redone graphics in the manner of the 16-bit generation Final Fantasy games and includes larger character sprites, remixed music by Tsuyoshi Sekito, and full graphical backgrounds in battle mode. It is from this base that the international version of Final Fantasy II began to take shape.

Judgement Silversword - Rebirth Edition.name: Judgement Silversword: Rebirth Edition
Judgement Silversword - Rebirth Edition.summary: Judgement Silversword has the unique distinction of being one of the few shooting games designed for a handheld console, and it's also one of the best! Destroying enemies as quickly as possible is essential to scoring in Judgement Silversword, giving the game a ruthless tempo.
